spec_review.note: This target-contract delta extends the complete TAMS 8.1 review. Its rules and not_applicable entries classify every ADR and Application Note added by the pinned 8.2 preview; review-count tests take the union with tams-v8.1.json.

rules.requirement: Initialisation segments are independently allocated Objects associated with Media Objects through init_object_id; clients do not infer or manufacture them from Flow metadata.
Flow Profiles are immutable single-essence technical contracts; profile-backed Flow PUTs carry profile_id instead of duplicate technical metadata, while Flow GETs remain expanded.
Storage allocation may explicitly request presigned or non-presigned PUT URLs and reports which mode each returned URL uses.
Storage Backend responses retain store type, provider, product, location, and read-only tags so authorisation policy can be evaluated without a lossy client model.
flow_collection order is meaningful and role is optional; Tamsin preserves deterministic input order and may supply human-readable roles without treating them as interoperable technical selectors.

not_applicable.reason: Source collected_by query filtering is a discovery operation outside the ingest write path.
Default ordering of generic listing endpoints does not alter ingest correctness; Profile paging follows opaque server cursors.
Editorial purpose is operator-owned descriptive metadata; Tamsin does not infer it from codecs, filenames, or collection position.
Transform deployment architectures are operational patterns; Tamsin exposes explicit local treatment profiles without requiring one architecture.
